search_order: repository-local Lean sources and target dossiers
all locally materialized packages named by the canonical lake manifest, with the manifest-pinned mathlib searched first

candidate_inclusion: a Lean 4 declaration whose elaborated type is the exact target
a Lean 4 declaration with a checked implication or equivalence to the exact target
a stronger Lean 4 theorem for which all representation and domain transports are explicit
a statement-only or adjacent declaration when clearly classified without proof credit
candidate_exclusion: a downstream use of the same pinned mathlib declaration without an independent terminal body
a binomial theorem, Vandermonde identity, hockey-stick identity, or factorial formula without an exact checked transport
an unrestricted recurrence counted as statement-identical without retaining the target's domain
a Lean 3 or other-prover result counted as Lean 4 closure
an unpinned URL, repository name, search snippet, or prose assertion counted as a proof body
immutable_revision_policy: Local candidates are bound to the lake-manifest revision, source tree, blob, file hash, and toolchain. Public candidates must be resolved to a full commit and, where available, tree and immutable raw-file hashes before receiving more than search-lead status.
trust_policy: Run Lean #print, #print axioms, and #print sorries on selected local declarations; inspect actual source bodies and use a comment-aware supplemental prohibited-construct scan. Unknown transitive trust fails closed.
negative_evidence_policy: A zero result is scoped only to the recorded service, query, cutoff, limits, and access state. Truncation, authentication failure, rate limiting, or checkpoints are access limitations, not negative evidence. Discovery saturation is not claimed.
dependency_policy: Use the existing canonical pinned .lake artifacts read-only. Do not update, build, clone, fetch, or otherwise mutate dependencies during this audit.
